rationale: The short thesis is uninvalidated — price is pinned at the LOD below VWAP (13.60) and the 9-EMA (13.58) in a risk-off tape (SPY -0.76%, VIXY +2.83%), with no reclaim of VWAP and no breach of the 13.61 stop; the falling-volume flat tape reads as consolidation after the breakdown rather than absorption failure. Holding keeps a defined asymmetric payoff (~$44 risk to the stop vs ~$166 to the 13.42 gap-fill target, well within the $222 remaining budget) while the setup still has 319 minutes to resolve. A flip to long is rejected: it would fight all-morning distribution and the macro tape for only ~3 cents to VWAP, which is far weaker evidence than merely staying flat.
